summary.headline: Questions on War and Divination
summary.text: Astrological question catalog entries 74–93, covering sexual conduct, poisoning, fear, hoped-for success, victory over enemies, household lordship, war, sieges, ambushes, dignities, and horse markets. The entries cite Theophilus, Palchus, Hermes, Mars, the Moon, Saturn, Leo, and the Sun, with cross-references to Florentine and Paris manuscripts and Engelbrecht’s Hephaestion.
